title: Tooling: 4.80× faster DisjointTensor.frame_data with identical frame receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, merged [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2001) left `DisjointTensor.verify_frames` / `frame_data` as an explicit next question after shipping closed-form verify support masks. Profiling on the historical full-size circuit (`h=26`, 60372 active nodes) shows most of `verify_frames` wall time inside the per-node reachable-target bit enumeration in `frame_data`.

[CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1044](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1044) already proved exact target-union propagation as an **opt-in** adapter under `research/disjoint-frame-unions/`. Production `scripts/experiments/disjoint_tensor.py` still used the historical bit loop. This PR promotes the same algebra into the default path, keeps every descendant bitset, source union and rectangle `require`, and leaves `verify_frames` receipts fieldwise identical. Only the source pin for `scripts/experiments/disjoint_tensor.py` changes inside the four certificates that bind that file.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs timing only `DisjointTensor(26).verify_frames` (construction excluded) gave median wall time **2.232 → 0.465 seconds (4.80×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every frame receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise (`distinct_nontrivial_transitions`, `frame_types`, flags).

Package: `research/disjoint-tensor-frame-unions/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/disjoint-tensor-frame-unions/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/disjoint-tensor-frame-unions/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/disjoint-tensor-frame-unions
python3.12 -I -B research/disjoint-tensor-frame-unions/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_DISJOINT_TENSOR_FRAME_UNIONS frame_cases=6 map_cases=6 certs=4 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/disjoint-tensor-frame-unions outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_DISJOINT_TENSOR_FRAME_UNION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. XOR-of-mask nonequivalence and corrupted-rectangle `ValueError` controls reject. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different objects or delivery): [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1044](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1044) (opt-in exact union propagation; this promotes it to production), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1793](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1793), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1861) (open; already conflicting with main; different primary pin `binary_phase_frames.py`), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1922), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1984](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1984), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1994](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1994), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2001) (support masks + open `verify_frames` / `frame_data` question this answers), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2100](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2100) (same `ternary-side.json` file, different pin key `ternary_side.py`). No competing open PR on production `frame_data` at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the disjoint-tensor / exclusion circuits. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
